summary: Two years of AI hiring compressed into one roster: Meta bought its way into frontier research with a $14.3 billion stake in Scale AI and a wave of nine-figure offers to researchers at OpenAI and Apple, OpenAI rebuilt its entire C-suite around consumer operators after Mira Murati, John Schulman, and Ilya Sutskever walked out in 2024, and Google and Microsoft answered with license-and-hire structures that pulled Windsurf, Character.AI, and Inflection AI's leaders in-house without a formal acquisition. Twenty-six verified moves anchor this roster, ranked by strategic weight: the capital behind the deal, the seniority of the role, and how directly the move shifted control over frontier research capacity. Founder-scientist labs defined the era's other current, as Sutskever, Gross, and Levy left OpenAI and Apple to build Safe Superintelligence, and Murati drew her own OpenAI alumni into Thinking Machines Lab, only for Meta to reclaim five of its founding engineers within the year.

moves.title: Chief AI Officer
moves.sourceTitle: Scale AI confirms 'significant' investment from Meta, says CEO Alexandr Wang is leaving
moves.read: A $14.3 billion stake bought Meta a data-pipeline relationship, a chief AI officer, and instant credibility for a lab built from scratch.
moves.why: The single largest capital commitment behind any 2024-2025 AI hire, and the appointment that created Meta Superintelligence Labs.

moves.title: AI Products Lead, Meta Superintelligence Labs
moves.sourceTitle: Ilya Sutskever becomes CEO of Safe Superintelligence after Meta poached Daniel Gross
moves.read: Meta's attempt to buy Safe Superintelligence outright collapsed, so it hired the startup's chief executive instead.
moves.why: Gave Meta a proven product leader with Apple and founder-scale credibility, and forced a leadership change at a rival lab in the same week.

moves.title: Chief Scientist, Meta Superintelligence Labs
moves.sourceTitle: Meta Poached Its New Chief Scientist for Superintelligence From OpenAI
moves.read: Meta reached past a title and pulled one of ChatGPT's own architects into its new lab's top research seat.
moves.why: Gave Meta a direct technical line to the model architecture behind OpenAI's flagship product.

moves.title: Researcher, Meta Superintelligence Labs
moves.sourceTitle: Apple Loses Top AI Models Executive to Meta's Hiring Spree
moves.read: A package reported above $200 million gutted Apple's foundation-models leadership in a single signature.
moves.why: The most expensive individual offer reported in the two-year window, and the clearest sign Apple had become a supplier of AI talent rather than a destination for it.

moves.title: CEO of Applications
moves.sourceTitle: OpenAI hires Instacart CEO Fidji Simo as head of applications, reporting to Altman
moves.read: OpenAI handed its consumer business to a chief executive who had already scaled a public-facing product to hundreds of millions of users.
moves.why: OpenAI's clearest signal that commercializing ChatGPT required an operator's discipline, not another researcher.

moves.title: AI Leader, Google DeepMind
moves.sourceTitle: Google hires Windsurf CEO Varun Mohan, others in $2.4 billion AI talent deal
moves.read: Google paid $2.4 billion for a license to Windsurf's coding-agent technology and its chief executive, leaving Windsurf itself standing as a separate company.
moves.why: Established the license-and-hire template Google reused twice inside eighteen months to add frontier talent while avoiding a formal acquisition.

moves.title: Chief Executive Officer, Microsoft AI
moves.sourceTitle: Mustafa Suleyman, DeepMind and Inflection Co-founder, joins Microsoft to lead Copilot
moves.read: A DeepMind co-founder walked a chatbot startup's leadership team straight into Microsoft's Copilot organization.
moves.why: The earliest and largest license-and-hire deal of the period, and a template UK regulators later declined to challenge.

moves.title: Co-Founder
moves.sourceTitle: Safe Superintelligence Inc.
moves.read: OpenAI's own co-founder and chief scientist took the company's founding alignment philosophy and rebuilt it as an independent lab.
moves.why: Removed OpenAI's most senior technical co-founder and, within a year, produced a $30 billion independent rival.

moves.title: Founder and Chief Executive Officer
moves.sourceTitle: OpenAI cofounder John Schulman is joining Mira Murati's startup after brief stint at Anthropic
moves.read: OpenAI's former chief technology officer built a new lab and began pulling former colleagues back out of the companies they had scattered to.
moves.why: Created the founder-scientist lab that later drew John Schulman away from Anthropic and became a magnet for OpenAI alumni.

moves.title: AI Leader, Google DeepMind
moves.sourceTitle: Ex-Google engineers who founded Character.AI rejoin company with AI partnership
moves.read: A Transformer co-inventor who left Google in 2021 returned through a $2.7 billion licensing deal rather than a rehire alone.
moves.why: Google's first use of the license-and-hire structure, reclaiming talent it had let walk away three years earlier.

moves.title: Chief Financial Officer
moves.sourceTitle: OpenAI welcomes Sarah Friar (CFO) and Kevin Weil (CPO)
moves.read: OpenAI added public-company-grade financial leadership more than a year before its next fundraising milestones.
moves.why: Signaled OpenAI's finance function was scaling toward the discipline a future public offering would demand.

moves.title: Chief Product Officer
moves.sourceTitle: OpenAI hires Sarah Friar as CFO, Kevin Weil as Chief Product Officer
moves.read: OpenAI paired its new finance chief with a product leader hired the same day, filling two C-suite seats in one announcement.
moves.why: Completed a same-day double hire that gave OpenAI product and finance leadership ahead of its 2024 growth push.

moves.title: Researcher
moves.sourceTitle: OpenAI cofounder John Schulman is joining Mira Murati's startup after brief stint at Anthropic
moves.read: An OpenAI co-founder chose a safety-focused rival over staying through the company's post-Murati rebuild.
moves.why: Opened a two-hop migration that eventually carried RLHF expertise from OpenAI through Anthropic to Thinking Machines Lab inside ten months.

moves.title: Alignment Researcher
moves.sourceTitle: Jan Leike
moves.read: OpenAI's alignment co-lead resigned and moved directly into a rival's safety organization within the same season.
moves.why: Carried core alignment-research expertise out of OpenAI and into Anthropic at the same moment Sutskever was leaving to found SSI.

moves.title: Chief Financial Officer
moves.sourceTitle: Krishna Rao joins Anthropic as Chief Financial Officer
moves.read: Anthropic professionalized its balance sheet with its first-ever chief financial officer as revenue approached hyperscaler scrutiny.
moves.why: Anthropic's clearest institutional-finance signal of the period, arriving as its funding rounds scaled toward frontier-lab size.

moves.title: AI Leader, Google DeepMind
moves.sourceTitle: Google hires Windsurf CEO Varun Mohan, others in $2.4 billion AI talent deal
moves.read: Windsurf's co-founder joined Mohan inside DeepMind, deepening Google's coding-agent bench in the same transaction.
moves.why: Paired with Mohan's move, it gave Google a complete coding-agent leadership team rather than a single hire.

moves.title: Interim Chief Executive Officer
moves.sourceTitle: Scale AI confirms 'significant' investment from Meta, says CEO Alexandr Wang is leaving
moves.read: Scale AI promoted from inside the same afternoon Wang's departure was announced, avoiding a leadership vacuum during its highest-profile deal.
moves.why: Kept Scale AI stable for Meta's minority-stake partnership at the exact moment its founder departed.

moves.title: Co-Founder
moves.sourceTitle: Safe Superintelligence Inc.
moves.read: A former OpenAI researcher traded a research role for founder equity in Sutskever's new lab.
moves.why: Completed Safe Superintelligence's three-person founding bench alongside Sutskever and Gross.

moves.title: Researcher, Meta Superintelligence Labs
moves.sourceTitle: Apple AI Crises Deepen as Search Exec Ke Yang Moves to Meta
moves.read: Meta's Apple raid extended past foundation models into the search organization within days of Pang's departure.
moves.why: Showed Meta's Apple recruiting reached beyond one team, widening the damage to Apple's AI bench.

moves.sourceTitle: Mira Murati, OpenAI's technology chief, becomes the latest exec to leave the company
moves.read: OpenAI's chief technology officer exited alongside two senior research executives on a single day.
moves.why: The triggering departure that forced OpenAI's fastest C-suite rebuild of the two-year period.

moves.title: Researcher
moves.sourceTitle: OpenAI cofounder John Schulman is joining Mira Murati's startup after brief stint at Anthropic
moves.read: A brief stint at Anthropic ended with Schulman rejoining former OpenAI colleagues at Murati's new lab.
moves.why: Completed a rare two-hop career path that traced the field's talent gravity across three labs in ten months.

moves.title: Chief Executive Officer
moves.sourceTitle: Ilya Sutskever becomes CEO of Safe Superintelligence after Meta poached Daniel Gross
moves.read: Sutskever took the chief executive title himself the same week Meta hired away his co-founder.
moves.why: Put OpenAI's former chief scientist in sole command of a $30 billion independent lab after Meta's acquisition attempt failed.

moves.title: Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer
moves.sourceTitle: Safe Superintelligence Inc.
moves.read: Apple's former AI lead co-founded Safe Superintelligence more than a year before Meta drew him away.
moves.why: Marked Apple's earliest senior AI departure of the period, more than a year before its 2025 losses to Meta.

moves.title: Superintelligence Labs Leadership
moves.sourceTitle: Alexandr Wang and Nat Friedman: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2025
moves.read: Time named Friedman alongside Wang as a defining leader of Meta's new lab in its 2025 influence ranking.
moves.why: Rounded out Meta Superintelligence Labs' founding leadership pair alongside Wang.

moves.title: Board Member
moves.sourceTitle: Scale AI confirms 'significant' investment from Meta, says CEO Alexandr Wang is leaving
moves.read: Wang kept a formal seat on Scale AI's board even after moving his day-to-day work to Meta.
moves.why: Preserved a governance link between Meta and Scale AI beyond the 49 percent equity stake itself.

moves.person: Thinking Machines Lab founding team (five engineers)
moves.title: Researcher, Meta Superintelligence Labs
moves.sourceTitle: Meta has hired five founding members of Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab in a systematic talent raid
moves.read: Meta reclaimed five of Murati's own founding engineers less than a year after her lab formed around them.
moves.why: Showed Meta's recruiting reached past incumbents and into the founder-scientist labs built to compete with it.
